newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruntal backs Robotic.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruntal backs Robotic.

text.p: -- Gruntal analyst Mark Langley said the fundamentals for Robotic Vision Systems Inc remain intact, but that he recommends waiting for "the dust to settle" before taking advantage of any buying opportunity.
-- said the stock has sold off as an institutional holder works through a large sell order.
-- said Federal Aviaion Administration award to company of $557,500 to research and develop an on-aircraft wide area ice detection system lends credibility to the company's technology.
